reproduction_notes: Re-running run_experiment.py from the repo root with the frozen files present reproduces raw_results.json bit-identically (all RNG seeded; verified across two runs with differing storage fields: headline numbers identical).

No git add/commit/push/reset/switch was performed during this experiment; the experiment directory contains only producer artifacts and unmodified frozen inputs.
